title: Mass Uncertainty Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the mass uncertainty equation as Γ ∼ ℏ(γ1 + γ2).

title: Lifetime Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the mean lifetime τ = 1/(γ1 + γ2).

title: Isospin Conclusion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must conclude that the isospin of particle X is 2.

title: Isospin Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention that isospin is conserved in strong interactions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the decay rate calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the uncertainty relation derivation.
